purpose: Attach the authenticated rotated-AFF3 operation to the real Qwen3.8-27B llama.cpp graph and prevent the replaced projection tensor from being loaded, without opening performance or whole-model quality measurements.

development_artifact.role: authenticated direct-v43 layer-0 image used only to establish loader and graph attachment before trained-v44 exists

integration_contract.activation: QWEN38_AFF3_DIR plus mandatory explicit QWEN38_AFF3_LAYERS; no sidecar environment means an unchanged upstream graph
integration_contract.development_partial_layer_mode: an explicit comma/range layer set is permitted for structural validation but cannot satisfy promotion
integration_contract.full_attention_seam: replace blk.N.attn_output/wo multiplication after the sigmoid gate
integration_contract.linear_attention_seam: replace blk.N.ssm_out multiplication after gated normalization
integration_contract.projection_tensor_loading: use TENSOR_SKIP for wo or ssm_out only when that exact layer has an authenticated AFF3 image
integration_contract.tasking: four GGML CPU tasks partition the Cartesian token-by-16-row-tile space; each task owns rotation and A8 scratch
integration_contract.image_lifetime: read-only mmap and derived FP32 cosine/sine coefficients live with the llama model
integration_contract.callback_lifetime: per-node scratch and callback userdata live with the constructed Qwen graph
integration_contract.lora_on_replaced_projection: unsupported and must fail closed rather than silently bypass the adapter

promotion_sequence: compile and validate the exact transformed llama.cpp tree without competing with v43
after v43 releases host memory, load the real Qwen3.8-27B model with one explicit development layer and prove graph execution parity
after v44 passes, materialize and authenticate all 64 trained AFF3 images
after v45 passes, attach the sensitivity-selected post-block residual operation
require the exact 0-63 AFF3 layer set before whole-model capability and performance gates
claim_boundary: A v49 development pass can prove exact source transformation, tensor-skip wiring, and real Qwen graph attachment. It cannot establish trained-v44 behavior, complete mixed-model correctness, throughput, quality, memory, energy, novelty, or a breakthrough.
